edition.alertText: Iran escalating: 12 ships attacked this week, highest since war began

situation: The Strait of Hormuz saw its worst week of attacks since the war began on February 28. UKMTO confirmed at least 12 ships were hit in the seven days to October 16, with one sunk (M/V GFS Pride), two disabled and three damaged. Kpler measured crude flows at 11.6 million barrels a day for the week to October 13, about 68% of the 17.1 million bpd pre-war baseline.

Both the US and Iran claim control of the strait. CENTCOM's Brad Cooper said 400 ships and 100 million barrels passed through last week; Iran's IRGC said a supertanker carrying over 2 million barrels caught fire on Saturday after hitting a mine. Brent jumped 3.6% to near $110 on Friday, its first touch of that level since May. VLCC tanker rates are around $1.3 million a day.

Iran set seven conditions for reopening the strait on October 4 and declared a prohibited zone on September 5. The US says its blockade has cost Iran $25 billion in oil export income. After the November 3 midterms, the US is reportedly prepared for larger operations.

supplyChain.name: Sulfur
supplyChain.text: Global exports down 45% from pre-war. 600kt stranded in Gulf at April peak. Byproduct — cannot ramp output. MEG supplied ~35% of global urea and 25% of ammonia.

supplyChain.name: Sulfuric Acid
supplyChain.text: China banned exports Apr-Aug (700kt/yr quota replaced). SX-EW copper producers (15% of global cathode) fully exposed. Huayou cut Indonesian nickel HPAL output 50%.

supplyChain.name: Fertilizer
supplyChain.text: OCP's last MEG sulfur cargo: April 10. Mosaic cut US phosphate output ~2M tonnes. North American sulfur flowing to Africa at historic premiums.

supplyChain.name: LNG
supplyChain.text: Qatar LNG (~20% of global trade) largely blocked. Europe 12-14% LNG was Qatar. Asian buyers switching back to coal — Newcastle at 3-year high $150/t.

supplyChain.name: Petrochemicals
supplyChain.text: MEG ethylene/polyethylene exports disrupted. Gulf petrochem complex cut to ~60% capacity. Dow, LyondellBasell margins widening on supply constraint.
